# Size-frequency weighting — report (generated by analysis/experiments/size_weighting_report.py)

Weighted refits against the cached unweighted fits, same folds. Variants: `a0.5c10` = α 0.5, cap 10.0, `a1c10` = α 1.0, cap 10.0, `a1` = α 1.0, cap none. MAE in gold; balanced MAPE = mean of the per-size-band MAPEs; (Δ ± paired SE over the 5 folds). Bias = median residual % (+ = the model overprices). V4 `fixed` keeps the unweighted size powers, `nested` searches them again under the weights.
